name: M3_ARS200MI_SearchInvoices
description: Searches for Accounts Receivable Transactions given many different search criteria.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number where the invoice transaction is recorded.

inputParameters.name: DIVI
inputParameters.description: Division responsible for the invoice transaction.

inputParameters.name: YEA4
inputParameters.description: Fiscal year of the journal entry for the invoice transaction.

inputParameters.name: JRNO
inputParameters.description: Journal number of the entry containing the invoice transaction.

inputParameters.name: JSNO
inputParameters.description: Journal sequence number identifying the invoice transaction within the journal.

inputParameters.name: TRCD
inputParameters.description: Transaction code indicating the type or origin of the ledger transaction, such as 10 for customer invoices or 20 for payments.

inputParameters.name: PYNO
inputParameters.description: Payer number identifying who is responsible for paying the invoice.

inputParameters.name: CUNO
inputParameters.description: Customer number of the invoiced customer.

inputParameters.name: CINO
inputParameters.description: Customer invoice number identifying the invoice.

inputParameters.name: INYR
inputParameters.description: Year in which the invoice was issued.

inputParameters.name: VSER
inputParameters.description: Voucher number series used for the invoice transaction's voucher.

inputParameters.name: VONO
inputParameters.description: Voucher number assigned to the invoice transaction.

inputParameters.name: IVTP
inputParameters.description: Code indicating the type of invoice or related transaction information.

inputParameters.name: TDSC
inputParameters.description: Transaction description for the invoice transaction taken from the accounting option.

inputParameters.name: SMCD
inputParameters.description: Salesperson responsible for the customer related to this invoice transaction.

inputParameters.name: CUCL
inputParameters.description: Customer group to which the invoiced customer belongs.

inputParameters.name: CUCD
inputParameters.description: Currency code of the invoice currency.

inputParameters.name: CRTP
inputParameters.description: Exchange rate type used to convert the invoice currency to local currency.

inputParameters.name: ARAT
inputParameters.description: Exchange rate used between the invoice currency and the local currency.

inputParameters.name: CUAM
inputParameters.description: Invoice amount in the invoice currency for this transaction.

inputParameters.name: DCAM
inputParameters.description: Number of decimal places used for invoice amounts.

inputParameters.name: VTAM
inputParameters.description: Total VAT amount for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: IVDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the invoice was issued.

inputParameters.name: RVDT
inputParameters.description: Follow-up date used as an extended due date for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: DUDT
inputParameters.description: Due date for payment of the invoice.

inputParameters.name: ACDT
inputParameters.description: Accounting date to which the invoice transaction is posted.

inputParameters.name: BKID
inputParameters.description: Bank account ID used for the invoice payment.

inputParameters.name: TECD
inputParameters.description: Cash discount terms code applied to the invoice.

inputParameters.name: PYTP
inputParameters.description: Payment type classification used for the invoice payment.

inputParameters.name: PYCD
inputParameters.description: Accounts receivable payment method used for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: TEPY
inputParameters.description: Payment terms defining how the invoice due date is calculated.

inputParameters.name: RECO
inputParameters.description: Internal reconciliation code indicating whether the invoice transaction has been reconciled.

inputParameters.name: REDE
inputParameters.description: Internal reconciliation date when the invoice transaction was fully reconciled or paid.

inputParameters.name: SLOP
inputParameters.description: Accounting option code describing how payment variances on the invoice are handled.

inputParameters.name: CRST
inputParameters.description: Status of the payment receipt for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: PYRS
inputParameters.description: Remittance status for checks or drafts related to the invoice.

inputParameters.name: ACBL
inputParameters.description: Code indicating whether the invoice is included in a payment advice.

inputParameters.name: RMST
inputParameters.description: Status of payment reminders sent for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: LRDT
inputParameters.description: Date of the last payment reminder sent for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: RMBL
inputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether payment reminders are blocked for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: BLBY
inputParameters.description: User ID of the person who placed a stop payment on the invoice.

inputParameters.name: BLDT
inputParameters.description: Date when a stop payment was placed on the invoice.

inputParameters.name: RMQT
inputParameters.description: Number of payment reminders that have been sent for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: IIST
inputParameters.description: Status indicating whether the invoice is blocked from being included in interest invoices.

inputParameters.name: IICD
inputParameters.description: Code indicating whether the invoice is stopped from interest invoicing.

inputParameters.name: DTP5
inputParameters.description: Date when the customer paid the invoice.

inputParameters.name: IIAM
inputParameters.description: Accumulated penalty interest amount calculated for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: CLST
inputParameters.description: Debt collection status of the invoice.

inputParameters.name: CLCD
inputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the unpaid invoice may be turned over to debt collection.

inputParameters.name: ARCD
inputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the invoice transaction has been filed.

inputParameters.name: SAGS
inputParameters.description: Status of the group invoice that includes this invoice.

inputParameters.name: GRPD
inputParameters.description: Date assigned to the group invoice including this invoice.

inputParameters.name: TXID
inputParameters.description: Text identity referencing comments or notes linked to the invoice.

inputParameters.name: DFPT
inputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether a draft for the invoice has been printed.

inputParameters.name: DFPD
inputParameters.description: Date when the invoice draft was printed.

inputParameters.name: RGDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the invoice record was created in the ledger.

inputParameters.name: RGTM
inputParameters.description: Time when the invoice record was created in the ledger.

inputParameters.name: LMDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the invoice record was last changed.

inputParameters.name: CHNO
inputParameters.description: Change sequence number for the invoice record.

inputParameters.name: CHID
inputParameters.description: User ID of the person who last changed the invoice record.

inputParameters.name: LMTS
inputParameters.description: Timestamp of the last modification of the invoice record.

inputParameters.name: RESP
inputParameters.description: User ID of the person responsible for the invoice.

inputParameters.name: ADAT
inputParameters.description: Action date used for follow-up or other actions on the invoice.

inputParameters.name: DNRE
inputParameters.description: Reason code explaining why a debit note related to the invoice was created.

inputParameters.name: APRV
inputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the invoice has been approved for payment.

inputParameters.name: IVCL
inputParameters.description: Invoice class categorizing the invoice for country-specific reporting and selection.

inputParameters.name: DEDA
inputParameters.description: Delivery date associated with the goods or services on the invoice.

inputParameters.name: MIGI
inputParameters.description: Internal migration status used to track data migration or conversion for the invoice record.
